decisions.decision: Board members to each schedule a meeting with the Town Manager and begin the review form; the Chair compiles the composite and the Board reviews it at an open meeting.
decisions.quote: each member should schedule a meeting with ms. lemieux and begin to complete the review form.

decisions.decision: Discussion of the Town Manager evaluation review process deferred to a future agenda, after Town counsel's opinion on Open Meeting Law effects.
